title: Nordic alien on Orcas Island

tellings.quote: You also saw a [music] Nordic alien. I did on Orcus Island
And all a sudden there's this person who literally looks like a male model, like a Scandinavian male model
tellings.difference: Adds that it happened on a friend's 20-acre property, that the being looked like a Scandinavian male model, and that it spoke without moving its mouth.
tellings.link_reason: The same Nordic being Brent met on Orcas Island.

as_told.title: Nordic-looking being on Orcas Island speaks to Brent without moving his mouth

plain: Brent Friedman, one of the creators of a 1990s television series about UFOs called Dark Skies, says he once met a "Nordic alien" on Orcas Island in Washington State. In UFO lore that phrase means a tall being who looks almost human. Friedman tells Michels it happened on a friend's 20-acre property: suddenly there was a figure who "literally looks like a male model, like a Scandinavian male model," and who spoke to him without moving its mouth.
